'''Fenelar armor''' was a type of highly valued heavy [[Armor/Legends|armor]] produced by the [[Fenelar]] species.<ref name="COMPLETE" />

==Characteristics==
[[File:Felenar_Armor.jpg|thumb|left|150px|A set of Fenelar armor, circa [[3951 BBY]]<ref name="TSL date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords'' to [[3951 BBY]].</ref> ]]

Manufactured by the [[Fenelar]], Fenelar armor was constructed from a variety of exotic minerals, including [[Phrik/Legends|Phrik]], which the Fenelar were the first to develop.<ref name="COMPLETE" /> Because of these materials, Fenelar armor was renowned for its heavy protection - comparable to [[Heavy battle armor/Legends|heavy battle armor]] - while retaining a high degree of flexibility, mobility, and relative light weight at twenty kilograms.<ref name="SWGM8" /> Combined, this made Fenelar armor handle and feel more like a medium armor in terms of weight and dexterity, while retaining all the benefit of a heavier armor.<ref name="SWGM8" /> In addition to its heavy protection, the bracers of Fenelar armor contained concealed combat knives, while the helmet contained an integrated [[Motion sensor/Legends|motion sensor]] array, [[Audio sensor/Legends|audio sensor]], [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], and [[Heat detector|infrared imager]].<ref name="SWGM8" /> Fenelar armor was deliberately designed to intimidate those who saw it, and each set was elaborately engraved; combined with its storied history and fierce reputation, this meant that those who wore the armor were sure to be feared.<ref name="SWGM8" />

==History==
The Fenelar species was exterminated by the [[Mandalorian Crusaders]] between [[5000 BBY/Legends|5,000]] and [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]], which effectively ceased production of new suits of the highly respected armor.<ref name="thotm">{{InsiderCite|80|The History of the Mandalorians: Exploring the Evolution of a Mighty Race of Warriors}}</ref><ref name="COMPLETE" /> This made Fenelar armor a scarce item past the [[Old Sith Wars]], and a collectors item in the [[Imperial Era]].<ref name="SWGM8" /> [[Gallo Memm]], a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] on [[Vaynai/Legends|Vaynai]] was one such collector during the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and kept a suit of Felenar armor valued at 55,000 credits within a transparisteel case at his compound.<ref name="SWGM8" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fenelar armor was referred to as Felenar armor in ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''.<ref name="kotor2" /> [[Jason Fry]] has confirmed this as a spelling mistake.<ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=posts/31061022|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=jasonfry|date=2010-07-06|time=7:48 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20200802120406/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-essential-atlas-and-galactic-cartography-official-discussion.21938930/page-147}}</ref>
